sloka: प्रचरेत नरः कामात् तस्य दण्डो वधः स्मृतः ।भरतः तु महीपालो वयम् तु आदेश वर्तिनः ॥४-१८-२३॥
transliteration: pracareta naraḥ kāmāt tasya daṇḍo vadhaḥ smṛtaḥ ।bharataḥ tu mahīpālo vayam tu ādeśa vartinaḥ ॥4-18-23॥

translations.english: 'Bharata is a king and we follow his command. How can you, who have strayed from dharma, go unpunished?
